verses.mystical_translation: I will praise thee, O the Living Presence, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the patterns rooted in harm, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
But the Living Presence shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
the Living Presence also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, the Living Presence, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
Sing praises to the Living Presence, which dwelleth in Zion, the holy center: declare among the people his doings.
When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
Have mercy upon me, O the Living Presence; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion, the holy center: I will rejoice in thy deliverance and wholeness.
The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
the Living Presence is known by the judgment which he executeth: the patterns rooted in harm is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
The patterns rooted in harm return to Sheol—all nations that forget the Divine.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
Arise, O the Living Presence; let not man prevail: let the nations be judged in thy sight.
Put them in fear, O the Living Presence: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

contemplative_note: The cry of the oppressed is not forgotten even when empires behave as though it is.
safety_note: Ancient nation-language cannot be transferred to modern ethnic or religious targets. Divine judgment is not human permission for collective punishment.
